facts.fact: DLA Piper, last modified 17 February 2026 (date is the document's), says Mozambique has no specific data protection law and does not generally restrict cross-border transfers, but that data export requires authorisation from the data subject or a court decision, with the Constitution restricting disclosure to third parties without consent and the ratified AU Convention's adequacy bar applying.
facts.system: Constitution of the Republic and AU Convention (Resolution 5/2019) as applied to data export

note: Also states INTIC lacks the Convention's power to authorise transfers; no published means or application stated.
